questions.s:
An unknown white solid, M, melts between 171 °C and 174 °C. When chromatography is performed with water as the solvent, M produces only one spot on the chromatogram.

Which statement must be true about M?
o: M is impure as it melts over a range of temperatures.
M is pure as it produced only 1 spot on the chromatogram.
